issue.title: Try to run tests on Windows

body: Probably related to recent changes by @mhlopko on toolchain selection. Looking into it.
This sounds like a regression, so let me know when we have identified a cause and if there's an easy fix for a point release.

I believe this was introduced in 46e65d1. It was fixed in c3fb1db.

In the first commit, we modify the [toolchain selection](https://source.bazel.build/bazel/+/83870d626a0fd005db8bf44efaf56f42685dcee8:src/main/java/com/google/devtools/build/lib/rules/cpp/CToolchainSelectionUtils.java;l=71) process to depend on (in order):
1. 'toolchain_identifier' attribute of cc_toolchain, if present.
2. 'cpu' (and 'compiler' if specified) attributes of cc_toolchain, if present.
3. --cpu and --compiler command line options.

As the [mingw-gcc cc_toolchain](https://github.com/bazelbuild/bazel/blob/46e65d1fb236d0eea9d2f8511e7412d98b534fc6/tools/cpp/BUILD.static.windows#L78) has a 'cpu' attribute (and doesn't have a 'compiler' one to know the right compiler), Bazel selects the CToolchain by step 2, therefore ignoring the --compiler option.

c3fb1db adds 'toolchain_identifier' attributes to each of the cc_toolchains therefore forcing Bazel to select the right toolchain.

@katre, could you cherrypick c3fb1db ?
This will need to be a new patch release, 0.19.1. I'll start the process.
